tei:div.tei:p: 143) 'od gsal rdo rje'i gsang mdzod las/ rdo rje gro lod kyi bsnyen yig mdor bsdus bzhugs// 144)

snang mtha' rab khros dbang drag he ru ka// snyigs dus 'dul phyir gar dbang bzhad pa rtsal// de yi brgyud 'dzin chos kyi nyi ma sogs// 'dren mchog yab sras bde chen 'khor lor rol// gang de'i bzhed gzhung dag byed gtor// blo dman 'jug bde ke ta ka// rnam par dpyod pas blang ba la/ lha dang srung mas gnang ba stsol// de la dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid rtsa ba yan lag dang bcas pa'i dbang gis smin cing dam tshig dag pas bsnyen sgrub la 'jug par spro bas/ dben pa'i gnas su lde mig las 'byung ba'i sgrub phur srog 'khor/ rten gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad tshogs par byas nas/ yar gyi tshes brgyad skar ma rgyal la babs pa'i dgong mo dbang gi dus nas brtsams ste 'jug pa gsang sngags spyi'i lugs sam/ 'di nyid las/ gza' skar shis pa'i dmar po'i dus bab tshe// zhes gsungs pas gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs pa'i bcu drug la 'jug par gsungs pa ltar 145) byas te*/ thog mar bde ba'i stan la lam gyi sngon 'gro blo ldog rnam bzhi la zhag grangs ci nus su blo sbyongs/ dgong thun zhig la thun mgo bzung ba'i dbang du byas nas/ thun gyi sngon 'gro/ lus gnad chos bdun/ ngag gnad rlung ro bsal/ sems gnad kun slong bcos/ gsol ba 'debs pa brgyud 'debs rnams grub mtshams/ phrin las rgyas pa grub gnyis char 'bebs btang na shin tu legs kyang*/ re zhig 'don stabs bde phyir phrin las bsdus pa dngos grub char 'bebs nyid btang ba'i dbang du byas na/ cho ga'i yan lag rnams kyang de dang 'tshams pa tsam las mi 'byor bas/ de'i dbang du bshad na rgyas pa gtong tshul shugs kyis shes par 'gyur ba dang*/ der ma zad grub pa'i dbang phyug gter ston chen po nyid kyi phyag bzhes sras blo bzang sogs gser gyi pad+mo'i phreng ba ltar bzhugs pa'i zhal las rtogs pas der zad/ 'dir stabs bde zhing don che ba

146) snying por dril na/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas che mchog pad+ma drag po'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra pa mā dzaḥ sa tshogs zhing gsal ba'i spyan sngar/ ā: rang rig khro rgyal he ru ka: rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi: gnyis snang 'khrul pa'i sems can kun: gnyis med ngang du sems bskyed do: lan gsum/ ho: skyabs yul rtsa gsum lha tshogs la: sgo gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba bla maid mchod: dam tshig nyams chag mthol lo bshags: gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang: 'bras bu sngags kyi chos 'khor bskor: mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: dge tshogs byang chub chen por bsngo: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa/ tshogs zhing rnams rang la tim par bsam/ gang dag 'dir gnas tsam gyis dkar gtor 'bul/ bgegs gtor/ sarba bighan+na na maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo sogs dang / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: gsang ba sngags kyi dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir: 'du ba'i skabs med 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun: 'dod yon gtor 147) ma khyer la so sor dengs: gal te mi 'gro skabs 'tshol glag lta na: thal ba'i rdul du brlag par gdon mi za: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ āḥhū ྃbadz+ra ma hā gu ru gro bo lod lo ka sarba yak+sha rak+sha badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes dang hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bskrad/ sgo drung sogs su tho dkor po gcig la/ hūm̐: sprul sku rgyal chen sde bzhi po: don la sangs rgyas yin mod kyang: gsang sngags bstan pa srung ba'i phyir: bar chad 'dul bar mdzad du gsol: oṃ dh+riṣ+ṭa rak+ṣa swa ha: oṃ bai ru dhaka swa hā: oṃ be ru pak+ṣa swa hā: oṃ bai shra ma ṣa swa hā: zhes bka' brgyad rang shar du 'byung ba lta bu brjod nas tho byang gzur/ srung 'khor ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hū: khro tshogs slar 'dus steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun: ye shes me klong khro tshogs sprin ltar 'khrigs: lcags sdig grangs med sna tshogs mtshon chas gtams:

gzhom bral srung ba'i 'khor lor lhun gyis grub: oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+ruṃ: byin dbab pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: 'og min chos dbyings rab 'byams 148) zhing khams nas: sgyu 'phrul rtsa gsum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: thugs dam bskul lo dbyings nas bzhengs su gsol: dbang dang byin rlabs dngos grub stsol cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsalaḥ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ sid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: badz+ra sa ma ya dza: a we sha ya a ā: mchod rdzas byin rlabs ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐: dngos por 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma kun: zhen bral mchod pa'i sprin du spel: sarba pū dza s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swa hā: de nas dngos gzhi/ hūm̐ hrī: chos dbyings ye nas dri med ka dag dbyings: sogs nas phrin las 'bring po ltar/ lha bskyed/ spyan 'dren/ bzhugs phyag mchod bstod bcas grub nas/ bzlas dmigs la rtse gcig tu gzhol bas sid+dhi sngar bla sgrub bsnyen tshad ma song na 'bru 'bum dgos kyang long med pa'i dbang du na/ 'bum phrag ma bzhi tsam bzla/ rtsa bsnyen rab dung phyur man ci 'grub/ 'bring grangs bsnyen bzhi 'gyur/ tha ma'ang 'bru 'bum tsam nges par dgos te/ 'di nyid las/ bsnyen tshad rab 'bring tha gsum las: rtags kyi mtshan ma de ltar 'ong: zhes gsungs pa'i phyir na/ rab 'bring tha ma'i grangs ma gsungs nas yang*/ 149) 'di tsam yin par gor ma chag go spyi dril las sngags phris che chung las gsungs pa gang mos/ rtsa bsnyen gyi gsum cha tsam zla/ thun mthar dbyangs gsal/ rten snying rnams lan gsum gsum/ mchod bstod gong ltar/ srung ma'i gtor 'bul spyi dang*/ 'di'i gter srung gza' bdud rgyun gyi phrin las tsam btang*/ gzhung las/ rang rgyud dag phyir bshags pa sngon song bas// zhes gsungs pas rgyas par na rag skong bshags/ bsdu na brjod med don bshags tsam song nas/ tshogs byin rlabs/ hūm̐ hrī: bdag gi thugs las sogs dang*/

spyan 'dren/ hūm̐ hrī: sngon gyi bskal pa'i 'phros su bla ma sher bzang gi bskang bsdus sbyar/ tshogs phud/ hūm̐ hrī: bla ma rig 'dzin sogs dang bshags 'phros/ e hri tri badza aṅku sha dza: dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa 'gugs bstim dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: ma rig gzung 'dzin/ sogs kyis bsgral/ ma hā māṃ sa rak+ta king ni ri ti kha kha khā hīḥ sa stobs/ tshogs kyi mchod pa rgyan du rol a la la ho: sa tshogs la rol/ he ru ka dpal grong khyer du sogs kyis smon lam btab/ oṃ ā:hūm̐ ha ho hrī: sa lhag ma byin gyi brlab/ e ā ral+li pheṃ pheṃ: zhes pas mgron bsu/ hūm̐ hrī: dang po phud kyis sogs kyis lhag ma 150) bsngo ba la brtson du 'dzin/ bskul pa ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo: rnga yab zangs mdog dpal gyi ri bo nas: rig 'dzin o rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal: sprul dang yang sprul zhi khro 'bar ba'i lha: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: mdzod cig thugs dam gnyen po dgyes dgongs mdzod: rnal 'byor byang chub sgrub la 'tshe ba'i bgegs: phyi nang bar chad zhi ba'i phrin las mdzod: srung ma'i gtor ma la/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: sa 'gugs bstim dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ḥhoḥ sa bdud rtsir bsgyur/ sha sa nā rjes su gtor sngags btags pas phul/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams kyis/ mchod sbyin gtor ma sogs kyis phrin las gzhol/ hūm̐ bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang sogs kyis chad tho dang*/ hūm̐ bh+yo bod khams skyong ba'i kyis brtan ma dang*/ nṛ tri badz+ra aṅku sha dza: dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ sa 'gugs bstim dang / ham̐'u hrī: dbang drag rta mgrin sogs kyis rta bro brdung*/ oṃ a:badz+ra puṣ+pe/ sogs kyis sngags mchod dang*/ rig 'dzin pad+ma dbang drag khro bo'i rgyal: shin du 'chol ba rdo rje gro bo lod: bdud bgegs byad ma dam sri 'dul mdzad pa: 'bar khros he ru ka la phyag 'tshal bstod:

ces pas bstod/ 151) ma snyed yongs su zhes dang*/ oṃ pad+ma he ru ka sa ma ya sogs bzhi spel yig brgya bzlas bas nongs pa bshags/ 'dir ni gzugs dang sogs kyis tshogs mgron ye shes pa rten la bstim/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snang 'char shar ba'i sogs kyis bdag bskyed 'od gsal du bsdu/ slar yang lha mchog sogs kyis sgyu ma lta bu'-i lhar ldang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs shing go bsgo/ hūm̐ hrī: 'das mtshon dus gsum sogs kyis bsngo ba dang*/ hūm̐ hrī: bdag sogs mkha' mnyam sogs kyis smon lam btab/ hūm̐ hrī: rig 'dzin bla ma sogs kyis shis pa brjod do/ thor thun la skyabs sems mchod brlabs rjes/ yang zab snying gi dum bus gsal btab la bsnyen/ thun mthar mchod bstod dang*/ bsdu ldang man phrin las 'bring po ltar sbyar/ snga thun phyi thun rnams la phrin las 'bring po gtong lugs gong ltar yin/ thun mtshams rnams su gsang ba hūm̐ gi sgrub pa dang*/ yang gsang ye shes snying po rnams rtsal du bton bsnyen tshad grub nas mdun bskyed la brten pa'i bsnyen pa yang grub na legs pas yo byad rnams gzhung ltar tshogs pa dang las byang spyan 'dren gyi mgor/ oṃ ma ha kro dha rā dza a haṃ/ swa bha wa= mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ i maṇā/ a 152) bh+ruṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra na hūm̐/ ma hā ru tra ti ra baṃ/ pra be sha ya hūm̐/ khams gsum gyi sems can thams cad kyi rgyu dug lnga dang dug gsum thams cad gcig tu bsdus te thim pas rū tra'i phung po khrol gyis zhig te gsang chen rol pa'i dur khrod chen po'i dbus su/ rdo rje'i brag ri'i steng gnod byed byad ma dam sri pho mo gcal du bkram pa'i gdan la rgya stag dmar nag 'jigs su rung ba'i steng du 'khor 'das kun gyi spyi dpal 'chol ba'i khro rgyal stobs ldan rdo rje gro bo lod sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba/

zhi chags khros pa'i nyams dang ldan pa/ ber mdung dmar po gser gyi ha ris can dang chos gos sham thabs te zhi khro phyed ma'i chas/ glang ko'i stod g.yogs dang*/ zhing gi sked dkris/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs/ rus pa'i rgyan drug mi mgo khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu'i do shal/ dug sbrul gyi sha byas pa/ de'i steng du za 'og sngon po'i lding ber gsol ba/ zhabs la pags lham gsol zhing mchong rgyug 'phar ba'i gar gyis rol pa/ phyag g.yas gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu me 'bar 153) ba 'phyar stabs su 'dzin pas brgyud gsum dregs pa sde brgyad zil gyis gnon cing las la 'gyed pa/ phyag g.yon lcags srog gi phur bus byad gdon dam sri'i snying gar gzir ba'i mdzub rtse nas las byed sprul pa yak+sha me dbal dang*/ yang sprul lcags kyi sdig pa nag po dpag tu med par 'phro ba/ de'i thugs kar gsang bdag seng ge sgra sgrog yab yum/ spyi bor dbang chen rta mgrin yab yum/ de yi spyi bor khyung nag 'bar ba/ phyogs mtshams gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu la khro bcu yab yum za gsod dang bcas pa/ sgo bzhir sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi gnas pa'o/ byad zlog dang sbrel na/ las kyi dkyil 'khor thod mkhar gru gsum 'jigs su rung ba'i dbus su/ nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du sde brgyad srog yig gnas pa'i steng byad ma gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i gdan la dbang drag karma drag rtsal mthing nag srin po khros pa'i nyams can/ phyag gnyis thal mo rdeb pa/ sku smad gnam lcags kyi phur pa byad ma'i snying la gzir ba/ dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa/ 154) de'i shar du klu 'bum gnyan khri sa bdag stong gi gdan la/ 'jigs byed tshe bdag nag po 'khor lo dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa la gshin rje 'bum gyis bskor ba/ lhor byad gdon gi gdan la zlog byed sedha mu kha mthing nag phyag gnyis thal mo brdab cing sku smad lcags phur byad ma'i snying la gzir ba la dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyis bskor ba/

nub tu dgra bgegs kyi gdan la gshin rje 'char kha nag po dbu rgyan sku gdugs bang rim dgu pa/ phyag gnyis gtor zor bsnams cing sku smad lcags phur can la dregs chen bco brgyad kyis bskor ba/ byang du dgra bgegs kyi gdan la dregs pa kun 'dul mthing nag rdo rje dang lha klu'i mgo bo bsnams pa/ de'i mdun du klu bdud nā ga rak+sha mthing nag sbrul rigs 'bum gyi gdengs ka can/ phyag gnyis dug zor bsnams shing sku smad sbrul du 'khyil ba/ de dag la dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cus bskor ba/ gtso bo'i spyi bor khyung nag 'bar bas brgyan pa/ thams cad 'khor du dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa/ thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis bskul bas rang bzhin 155) gyi gnas nas khros 'khugs 'bar ba'i lha tshogs ser chen drag po rlung gis bskyod pa ltar spyan drangs par gyur/ de nas phrin las 'bring po ltar spyan drangs nas/ bstod pa yan dang*/ bdag bskyed bsnyen pa cung tsam grub rjes/ mdun bskyed thugs dkar pha lam gri: rdo rje rtse dgu'i lte bar hūm̐: 'bar 'khrugs sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: 'phro 'du'i 'od kyis don gnyis byas: oṃ ā:hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru gro bo lota lo ka sarba sha trum bigh+naṃ mār ya phaṭa: zhes pa gtso bor bzla/ tsaṇ+ḍa dang*/ hūm̐ bsnyen dang*/ drag sngags so lnga dang*/ de'i gsham du/ sarba shā trum bigh+nān e sa bh+yo zlog: ma ra ya phaṭa phaṭa: btang pa rnams kyang cung zad bzla/ thugs ka'i 'od kyi las dkyil gyi lha tshogs bskul bas bzlog bsad kyi las mdzad par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+sha kro dha rā dza ha he phaṭa: mang tsam bzla/ de'i gsham du/ sarba duṣ+ṭan bigh+nan mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog: sbrel ba dang*/ 'khor sngags/ ya ma rā dza snying khrag ra ma tsa: oṃ badz+ra sengha mu kha ha he phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ shar bh+yo: sha rī ram bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra 156) sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐:

ga ru ṭa sarba duṣ+ṭan dgra bgegs byad ma rbod gtong e sa bh+yo zlog: rbad sod bzlog ya: zhes dang*/ srung sngags ni/ mdun bskyed rtsa sngags dang drag sngags so lnga'i gsham du/ gnod byed bar chad gdon bgegs byas ma rbod gtong gi gnod pa thams cad srungs shig: sarba tsit+ta gzer thuṃ: big nan: trig nan: bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas srung shig: ces pa dang*/ zlog sngags ni/ rtsa sngags drag sngags gsham du/ e ka du na zlog: he ka du na zlog: gh+ra ma du na zlog: sa ka du na zlog: tsa dur snying la zlog: sum tri rak+sha zlog: ban dgra a mu ka byad gzor phur kha rbod gtong thams cad e sa bh+yo: sha rī raṃ bzlog ya: zhes dang*/ yang zlog rdo rje pha lam sngags/ oṃ hūm̐ trig khrom bh+yo: ma ni mā ra ni bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+ṣan bh+yo: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: mā ra ya: ya mar dza: kī la ya bh+yo: zhes pa rnams ci nus bzla/ stong tshig mchod bstod/ bka' srung gtor 'bul/ tshogs byin rlabs nas bar bshags yan grub pa dang*/ thugs dam bskul pa ni/ 157) hūm̐ bh+yo: dbang drag dur khrod rol pa'i gzhal yas nas: bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod: mthing nag rngam pa gar dgu'i dpal dang ldan: rigs bdag seng sgrog stobs ldan byang chub rgyal: sprul pa khro bcu yab yum za gsod bcas: sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi dang bka' srung tshogs: rnal 'byor gdung bas thugs dam rgyud bskul na: drag shul stobs rtsal ldan pas dbyings nas bzhengs: dam rdzas sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: mngon spyod phrin las gnyen po'i dus la bab: bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs: mdzod cig mdzod cig rnal 'byor phrin las mdzod: thugs dam dus la bab po sa ma ya:

gser skyems*/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ oṃ a:hūm̐ ho: sa brlabs la / mchog gsum ngo bo dpal mgon bla ma dang*/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ ma mgon gza' rdor dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams/ gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor mthu dpung skyed/ ces pa tsam gyis phul/ gzu dpang ni/ kyai: gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo mchog gsum lha: rab 'byams rtsa 158) gsum sgyu 'phrul zhi khro dang: pho mo ma ning char gtogs dregs byed sde: bdag ni ma nyes ma g.yo mkhyen pas gzigs: dam nyams las ngan dgra bgegs byad ma 'di: dge bcu khyad gsod mi dge dang du len: yongs la gnod cing sangs rgyas bstan pa bshigs: nyes med 'gro ba mang po'i srog dbugs sdud: bstan dang 'gro ba'i spyi dgra gdug can 'di: mngon spyod drag pos bsgral ba'i las brtsams na: mkhyen gzigs ldan rnams gzu dpang sdo grogs mdzod/ rnal 'byor bdag la mgon dang dpa' rogs kyis: mngon spyod drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: thugs dam gnad nas bskul lo phrin las mdzod: dmigs rten bskyed pa ni/ e las gnam lcags kyi khang sgrom zur gsum 'bar ba'i nang du nṛ tri las dgra bgegs gang la dmigs pa rid cing nyams thag pa'i bdag nyid du gyur: rnam shes 'gugs pa ni/ na mo dkon mchog rtsa gsum rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bden pa dang: sgyu 'phrul dbang drag rol pa'i dkyil 'khor bka' srung don nam rgya mtsho'i bka' bden pas: dgra 'dre bsam sbyor ngan pa'i bla srog rnam par shes pa gzugs ling ga 'di la khug dza: rtsa sngags/ 159) dza:hūm̐ baṃ ho: zhes bkugs la/ drag sngags so lnga'i mthar/ badz+ra de ba pra be sha ya phaṭa: na sha ya/ bhan+dha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya: mo ha ya phaṭaḥ kyis lha dang dbye/ hūm̐ hrī: che mchog 'bar ba'i las kyi pho nya ni: yak+sha me dbal sprul pa rlung ltar 'tshubs: 'gugs 'ching bsdom myos phyag rgya skar ltar rgyug: gzugs can gzugs med zhing bcu tshang ba yi:

dgra 'dre dam sri byad ma lha srung bcas: khug cig myos rengs smyo 'bog brgyal du chug: rgyob cig ye shes mtshon cha'i char phob la: tshe bsod bdag thim rnam shes dbyings su sgrol: sarba shā trun bigh+nan mā ra ya: mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ces pas bsgral/ hūm̐ hrī: phyes shig phyes shig lha tshogs zhal phyes shig: dam nyams rū tra bsgral ba'i sha khrag rus: lnga phung bla tshe srog dbugs ma lus pa: lha tshogs zhal du bstabs po kha raṃ khā hi: mgul du bsgril bar mdzod cig ā ral+li: lhag med dbyings du stims shig a la la: sarba shā trun bigh+nan 160) ma hā maṃ sa rak+ta kiṃ ni ri ti kha kha khā hī: zhes bstab po/ bar 'dir tshogs drang ba dang*/ lhag ma btang*/ bzlog pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nga ni dpal chen rdo rje gro bo lod/ mthing nag rab khros 'bar ba'i gar dgu ldan: khams gsum 'khor 'das zil gnon bran du bkol: sprul pa khro bcu za gsod las la rngam: brgyud gsum dregs tshogs 'dul zhing pho nyar 'gyed: che btsan 'gran bral dbang drag he ru ka: rnal 'byor bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: sngon las 'phral rkyen bar chad bzlog ཿpa'i phyir: bskul lo thugs dam drag po gnad nas bskul: bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas skur bzhengs shig: mdzod cig bzlog pa'i phrin las dus la bab: hūm̐ hūm̐: dbang drag rol pa'i drur khrod chen po nas: khro rgyal rdo rje gro lod thugs dam bskul: mthing nag 'bar ba e yi gzhal yas nas: thugs mchog khro rgyal yab yum thugs dam bskul: dmar nag gsung mchog rol pa'i dur khrod nas: pad+ma dbang chen yab yum thugs dam 161) bskul/ yon tan lhun gyis grub pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: stobs ldan bya khyung rgyal po thugs dam bskul/ phyogs bcu'i dregs pa bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su: bdud 'dul khro bcu yab yum bskul/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i phyogs bzhi'i sgo bzhi nas:

sgo skyong gdong mo rnam bzhi thugs= dkyil 'khor chen po'i 'khor yug la gnas pa'i: bka' srung gter srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di rol la: bskal ngan nad mtshon mu ge'i sna 'dren yi: gzugs can gzugs med bsam ngan sbyor rtsub zlog: phyi nang 'byung ba dgra gshed 'thab pa'i rkyen: ma rung chag che nyam nga thams cad zlog: mi dang mi min gdon las byung ba yi: byad zor rbod gtong than ltas ngan pa zlog: mi 'dod mi phyugs nad rigs thams cad zlog: lo zla zhag dang za ma'i kag rigs zlog: pho gdon mo gdon gdon rigs thams cad zlog: sngon las 'phral rkyen bkra mi shis pa zlog: sde brgyad gtad khram lha 'dre'i za kha zlog: mtha' dmag dus kyi g.yo 'khrugs thams cad zlog: bzlog go bsgyur ro phrin las dus la bab: 162) oṃ a:hūm̐ badz+ra gu ru gro bo lota lo ka sarba duṣ+ṭan mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha ma tha sa tsa sarba duṣ+ṭan mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog: sarba sha trun bigh+nan shā ri raṃ bh+yo zlog: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: kha la dza ma lo rbad nan: rā tsa du ling shag rbad nan: shig shig duṃ duṃ rbad nan: khroṃ khroṃ bh+yo rbad nan: rmugs rmugs rbad nan: tir tir rbad nan: tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: bh+yo bh+yo bh+yo: zlog ya: khyad par gyi bzlog pa ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: skye med dbyings las khros pa'i he ru ka: sa dgu'i bdag rtog 'joms mdzad dpal chen po: phrin las karma drag rtsal las la skul: bdag rtog ma rungs byad gdon rdul du rlog: 'jigs rung gshin rje rol pa'i dur khrod nas: rab khros 'jigs byed tshe bdag sku bzhengs shig: gshin rje bdun brgya nyer lnga las la skul: dur khrod gsang chen rol pa'i gnas mchog nas: dhā ki sengha mu kha sku bzhengs shig: rnal 'byor dbang mo nyer brgyad las la bskul:

dur khrod shin tu 'jigs pa'i e klong nas: gdug pa dug gri nag po sku bzhengs shig: 163) sngags bdag dregs chen bco brgyad las la skul: mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas: bcom ldan gsang ba'i bdag po dbyings nas bzhengs: dug gi rgya mtsho rba klong g.yo ba nas: gtum chen nā ga rak+sha gnad nas bskul: dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu las la ya: zlog sgyur drag po'i phrin las dus la bab: gzugs can gzugs med bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kyi: byad kha rbod gtong mi rung rdzas sbyor dug: phra man chos log ngan thabs rigs sngags kun: rang byas rang gshed phob la myur du sod: pho mo ma ning sde brgyad ngan sngags kyis: mnan gtad dkrugs la byad thag dum bur chod: dam nyams srung skyob byed pa'i lha srung rnams: rag gshed srog chod bdud kyi shan par phob: srung ba'i gur khang rdo rje'i mtshon gyis gzhom: mngon spyod byad ma zlog sod mthu ma chung: dgra bgegs byad ma gsod pa'i dus la bab: rigs sngags rbod gtong zlog pa'i dus la bab: phrin las dus la 164) bab po sa ma ya: 'jigs chen dregs tshogs sde brgyad las la ya: snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dam la 'dus: do nub zlog sgyur byed pa'i dus la bab: nam mkha' lha yi byad sna dgra la zlog: bar snang gnyan gyi byad sna dgra la zlog: sa gzhi sa bdag byad sna dgra la zlog: phyi pa mu stegs byad sna dgra la zlog: nang pa sangs rgyas byad sna dgra la zlog: bon po'-i ngan sngags byad sna dgra la zlog: dmar po btsan gyi byad sna dgra la zlog: khra bo gza' yi byad sna dgra la zlog: nag po bdud kyi byad sna dgra la zlog: gshin rjes khram btab gyim shing byad kha zlog: ma mo'i khrag rims dal yam byad kha zlog: sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra'i steng du zlog: dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra'i steng du zlog: dam nyams sdang dgra gdon bgegs steng du zlog:

dam sri byad ma rbod gtong steng du zlog: oṃ badz+ra rak+sha kro ha rā dza ha he phaṭa: ya ma rā dza snying khrag ra ma tsa: oṃ badz+ra saidha mu kha ha he phaṭa: 165) hūm̐ hūm̐ shar bh+yo: shā ri raṃ bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐: ga ru ṭa sarba duṣ+ṭan bigh+nan mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog: oṃ hūm̐ trig khrom bh+yo: ma ni ma ra ni bh+yo: ma ra du na bh+yo: rak+mo rak+shan bh+yo: ting ya rak+sha bh+yo: mā ra ya: yā ma rā dza: ki la ya bh+yo: dgra bgegs byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog ya: ā:de wa rā dza sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ya:ya ma rā dza sa ma ya e sa/ maḥyak+mo rak+mo sa ma ya e sa bh+yo/ bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: duḥpra ma rak+sha sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: ruḥrak+sha ra hu la du tri sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: tsaḥb+du la la tsa tri sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: shaḥyak+sha rak+sha sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: naḥnā ga rak+sha sa ma ya e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: lha srin sde brgyad kyis byad phur rbod gtong 'byung bzhir las bcol gtad khrom thams cad phyung phyung shigs shigs khrol khrol: dgra bgegs bsam sbyor ngan pa rnams kyi steng du bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: e sa bh+yo 166) zlog ya: hūm̐ dmar nag gtum drag rol pa'i dur khrod nas: phrin las karma drag rtsal 'khor bcas kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: snang srid byad ma rbod gtong thams cad zlog: oṃ badz+ra rak+sha kro dha rā dza ha he phaṭa: ya ma rā dza snying khrag ra ma tsa: oṃ badz+ra sedha mu kha ha he phaṭa: hūm̐ hūm̐ shar bh+yo: shā ri ram bh+yo zlog: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ phe laṃ hūm̐: ga ru ṭa sarba duṣ+ṭan bigh+nan mā ra ya e sa bh+yo zlog: dgra bgegs byad gdon mkhan gyi ma hā maṃ sa khā hi: ma hā rak+sha khā hi: ma hā king ni ri ti khā hi: de nas thugs dam bskul/

gsol ka bskyang*/ chad tho/ brtan ma/ rta bro/ mchod bstod/ nongs bshags/ brtan bzhugs/ bsdu ldang*/ bsngo smon bkra shis rnams bya'o/ de ltar zhag bdun tsam bsgrubs rjes/ bzlog pa'i mthar/ mchod brjod/ nongs bshags dang*/ mdun bskyed gtor ma ye shes pa: rang la bstim zhing dam tshig pa: dmag dpung dgra la rngam pa ltar: phrin las sgrub la chas par gyur: bzlog 167) sngags rnams ci nus bzla/ zab mdo bdud bzlog bcas bya/ sgo dbye ba ni/ hūm̐: phyogs bzhi'i sgo skyong gdong mo bzhi: thabs kyi phyag rgya dang po yis: phrin las rnam bzhi'i sgo bzhi phyes: gser skyems gnyen po 'di bzhes la: dgra bgegs steng du dmag sna drongs: zor lam dgra bgegs ste du phyes: badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma pra be sha ya phaṭa: zhes gser skyems mchod/ las byang bzhin/ bskul pa dang*/ chad tho btang*/ zor lam dbye ba ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: nyon cig steng 'og phyogs bcur gnas pa rnams: gtor zor gnyan po'i las la sku gzur cig: zor lam gnas pa gang dag su yang rung: mtho bas zhabs bskum dma' bas dbu smad cig: g.yas g.yon 'dug pa thams cad rang rang gzur: thams cad grogs mdzod dgra bgegs steng du chos: zor ya zor ya: 'gugs pa dang bcas/ zor 'phang ba ni/ bzlog gtor thams cad nad mtshon dug: gyur nas dgra khams ming med bsam: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: khams gsum snod bcud thams cad nga yi 168) dbang: snang srid brgyud gsum dregs pa nga yi bran: rtsa gsum dam can rgya mtsho las la chos: drag po'i dmar gtor sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag: nad mtshon bu yug thog ser 'tshub se 'tshub: bstan 'gro'i bde bcom dam sri gdon gyi rigs: byad phur zor kha ston pa sha za'i sde: yid la brnag pa'i dgra 'dre byur gsum gyi: tshe srog dbang thang gzugs phung yul 'khor bcas: ming gi lhag mar gyis shig sa ma ya: zor ya zor ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra gu ru gro bo lota lo ka sarba kro dha rā dza:

bdud pra mā ra ya rbad nan: sogs nas/ tshal pa tshal pa rbad nan: gnod byed dgra bgegs dam sri byad gdon rbod gtong mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs chag che nyam nga thams cad e sa bh+yo bh+yo zlog zlog: zhes zor 'phang*/ srung 'khor bsgoms/ sgo drung du brtan ma bskyang*/ rta bro brdung nang du log ste gab pa gsang ba'i lde mig ltar tshe 'gugs dang*/ gsol ka bskyang*/ rjes chog mchod bstod man sngar ltar bya/ phyi nyin tho rangs nas/
